front.title: MICA-NEX EXP-03: Controlled Evidence-Transfer and Authorization Boundary

abstract.t: This document defines a prospective, staged disclosure gate to preserve the distinction between authenticated laboratory records and independently verified physical results in MICA-NEX EXP-03. The plan makes explicit the prerequisites for contractual authority, signer independence, documented metrological traceability, calibration uncertainties, consent to data export and independent evaluation. The package includes a machine-readable checklist whose local code cannot authorize any disclosure. No external appointment, transfer, or physical measurement has occurred. The author provided research direction; technical drafting and tests were AI-assisted. Novelty has not been established.
